answer.reason: The verses tell of Darius signing the decree against prayer, freeing Daniel from the lions' den, and ordering all his realm to fear Daniel's God.

clauses.english: signed a decree forbidding prayer to any god or man but himself
clauses.quote: king Darius signed the writing and the decree

clauses.english: had Daniel taken up unharmed out of the lions' den
clauses.quote: commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den

clauses.english: decreed that men in all his kingdom fear the God of Daniel
clauses.quote: men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel

doubts: DAN 5:31 (took the kingdom) was left out because the summary already names him king of Chaldea.
